quote: We propose a new evaluation method, ALiiCE, Automatic LLM's Positional Fine-grained Citation Evaluation. Our method incorporates three metrics for evaluating citation quality, including citation recall and precision at the level of atomic claims, as well as the Coefficient of Variation of Citation Positions (CVCP).

We use TRUE, a fine-tuned T5-11B model as the NLI model for the judgement of entailment in citation quality.
